desc: Establish the monomial-summation criterion and identify the p=2 special case versus the p>2 surviving walk classes.
Derive and rigorously verify the closed-form correction for p>2, including the p=3 off-diagonal exception and global sign.
Combine the zero-free contribution and corrections into an O(N^3 log p) formula using binary matrix exponentiation.
Validate the implementation on all public sample tests.
